chunks: 2 – Jamāʿa ibn Saʿd, al-Juʿfī, al-Ṣāʾigh (the jeweler). Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh (peace be upon him).
He went out with Abū al-Khaṭṭāb and was killed. He is weak in his ḥadīth, and his madhhab is what I have mentioned.

key_terms.أَبُو الْخَطَّابِ: Abū al-Khaṭṭāb (a companion, often identified with al-Mukhāriq)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abū ʿAbdillāh (Imam al-Sādiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.مَذْهَبُهُ: His madhhab (school of thought or belief)

ai.seo_question: Who is Jamāʿa ibn Saʿd and what is his status in hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry describes Jamāʿa ibn Saʿd al-Juʿfī, a jeweler who narrated from Imam al-Sādiq (peace be upon him). He is noted as being weak in his narrations and was killed alongside Abū al-Khaṭṭāb.

en.tashayyu: 2 – Jamāʿa b. Saʿd,  al-Juʿfī.  al-Ṣā’igh (the jeweler).  Narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh   . عليه السلام
Went out with Abū al-Khaṭṭāb and was killed.  He is weak in his ḥadīth.  His madhhab is what I have mentioned.
